title: Selena Gomez's London Takeover: A Dessert Tour and a New Mystery
summary: Selena Gomez is turning London into her personal playground — and dessert is involved. The 33-year-old singer-actress shared a behind-the-scenes peek at the sixth season of Hulu's *Only Murders in the Building*, and it's already deliciously fun. In a video posted to Instagram on Sunday, Gomez jumps on Sabrina Carpenter's viral 'House Tour' trend, lip-syncing to the track while enthusiastically pointing to the tiers of an elaborate dessert tray at a restaurant. It's a perfect mix of goofy and glam, and it's got fans hyped for what's to come. This season marks a major shift: for the first time, the Emmy-winning series is filming overseas. The move to London isn't random. Season five ended on a cliffhanger with the main trio — Gomez, Steve Martin, and Martin Short — listening to a podcast about a U.K. woman who allegedly murdered a descendant of the royal family before fleeing to the United States. So, the London setting is a natural — and exciting — next chapter. Gomez captioned her photo carousel, 'First week in London,' with a smiling face with hearts emoji and a U.K. flag. She also expressed deep gratitude to fans: 'I want to thank our community and fans... for allowing us to even have a season 6! We are eternally grateful we can bring any of you any sort of joy.' The show, which premiered in 2021, has become one of Hulu's biggest hits, earning seven Emmys out of 56 nominations. Carpenter's 'House Tour,' from her album *Man's Best Friend*, peaked at No. 27 on the Billboard Hot 100. Gomez's playful tribute is a reminder that even global stars can't resist a good trend — especially when sugar is involved.
why_it_matters: The story shows how a hit streaming series must keep reinventing itself to stay exciting, and how fans and social media trends can shape the buzz around big productions. For young viewers, it's a window into how entertainment is created across continents and how community support can keep a show alive.

perspectives.description: Devoted fans are thrilled to see the trio in a fresh location, anticipating new storylines and deeper mysteries. The London move signals the show's confidence and ambition, potentially attracting an even larger global audience.

Some critics worry that moving the action far from the show's original New York charm might dilute its cozy, building-centered dynamics. There's also a risk that the cross-Atlantic plot could feel forced or alienate viewers who loved the local feel.

Relocating a successful series is a common strategy in television to refresh interest and open narrative possibilities. The show's ability to win Emmys while staying fun and accessible highlights the growing appetite for genre-blending comedies on streaming platforms.

If the London season succeeds, it could pave the way for more globe-trotting seasons, turning the series into an international anthology within New York's neighborhood. The positive fan reaction may also encourage other streamers to let hit shows expand their geographic footprint sooner.
